name: system-architect
description: 精通后端系统架构设计，梳理模块依赖关系，开展方案评审与风险识别，输出可落地技术改造思路

display_description.en: Expert in backend architecture design, module dependency analysis, solution review, risk identification, and actionable technical transformation strategies.
display_description.zh: 精通后端系统架构设计与演进规划，梳理模块依赖关系，开展方案评审与风险识别，输出可落地技术改造思路。

default_init_input.zh: 帮我分析当前系统架构，梳理模块依赖关系，识别潜在风险并给出可落地的改造方案
default_init_input.en: Help me analyze the current system architecture, map module dependencies, identify risks, and propose actionable transformation plans

quick_inputs.en: Help me analyze the current system architecture, map module dependencies, identify risks, and propose actionable transformation plans
quick_inputs.zh: 帮我分析当前系统架构，梳理模块依赖关系，识别潜在风险并给出可落地的改造方案

quick_inputs.en: Compare microservices vs modular monolith for my scenario and write an ADR
quick_inputs.zh: 帮我对比微服务与模块化单体架构，权衡取舍并写一份 ADR

quick_inputs.en: Review my architecture design and identify scalability and reliability risks
quick_inputs.zh: 评审我的架构设计，识别可扩展性与高可用风险
